basis: 58 answered customer threads with identifiable first archived incoming email and first old-support-agent reply, within the most recent 30 days of the supplied archive.
agent_identification: Recurring named product-team signatures; the archive does not independently prove AI/vendor provenance.
time_basis: Elapsed calendar minutes calculated from RFC Date headers, normalized to UTC; not business hours.
limits: First archived reply per Gmail thread does not necessarily equal first reply of an entire customer case.
Sample estimate, not an official vendor SLA.
filters: Exclude prior substantive support replies in the thread.
Exclude automated notices, vendor invoices, campaigns, sales solicitations and explicit test emails.
Require a direct In-Reply-To link to an incoming email and an original customer message in the thread.
